title: What clients say
subtitle: Real results from real businesses we have worked with.

items.name: Maria Alvarez
items.quote: Sentellix completely changed the way we book appointments and send reminders. The number of people who do not show up decreased by 40 percent in one month. Now I have my evenings free again because Sentellix rebuilt our booking and reminder flow.

items.name: James Carter
items.quote: Their AI follow-up system reached out to 60 leads that I thought were a lost cause. Two of them actually turned into deals within six weeks. That was enough to cover the cost, for the year.

items.name: Priya Shah
items.quote: What I liked the most was the honesty. They said to us that we did not need a custom agent we just needed an automation. This saved the company thousands of dollars. The honesty, from them was really great. They told us that a smarter automation was the way to go, not a custom agent.

items.name: Sophie Bennett
items.quote: Setup was painless and the handover documentation is genuinely good. We run the system ourselves now and it just works.
